audience: First-run users who need one finished loop before any desk: computer alive, one file read, one connector proved

bots.why: Proves the cloud computer is alive with one command and its raw output, before any connector is connected.
Official first task: one attached file becomes five quoted bullets, every date, and the open questions. Zero integrations.
Installed is not enabled and enabled is not working. One read-only call and a dated line with a real returned value.

rooms.name: First Hour
rooms.description: The three first-hour desks in one room: computer alive, first file read, plugin proved. Assembled by gb-room-topology; members resolve through the identity map only.

boundary.action: Select exactly one eligible identity, record the selection, complete OAuth, and bind it to plugin-proof.

proof.semantic_expectation: The selected identity is bound to plugin-proof and one declared read returns a real account value in the same conversation.

recovery.residue: Disable the selected connector and revoke its OAuth grant; retain the selection receipt and failed proof.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill on plugin-proof; do not copy or reinterpret its body.

proof.semantic_expectation: plugin-proof states the installed-is-not-working rule and reports the actual value from the declared read.

approval.boundary: before enabling the skill on plugin-proof

recovery.residue: Disable the skill on plugin-proof; preserve its source digest and last proof result.

boundary.action: Enable the exact skill only on the three declared routine owners.

proof.semantic_expectation: Each declared routine has a dated first run, or its exact failure is recorded.

approval.boundary: before enabling the skill on routine owners

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; retain routine ids and first-run receipts.

boundary.action: Enable the skill and enter credentials only through the variable card.

proof.semantic_expectation: Required variable names are present while no credential value appears in plan, chat, or receipt.

recovery.residue: Remove the variable card binding; retain names-only evidence.

boundary.action: Enable the exact plan-eligibility rule on plugin-proof.

proof.semantic_expectation: plugin-proof separates available account features from ineligible ones without attempting an ineligible action.

approval.boundary: before enabling the skill on plugin-proof

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; preserve the entitlement readback used by the plan.

boundary.action: Enable the exact takeover boundary on plugin-proof; the Bot must pause at login and 2FA.

proof.semantic_expectation: A login or 2FA prompt produces WAITING_HUMAN without exposing or inventing a credential.

recovery.residue: Leave the task paused and retain the last non-secret screen state.

human_steps: Create the hello-computer Bot and run its command once; the pasted kernel string is the receipt that the VM answers.
Attach one real file to first-file-desk; do not skip this for a description of a file.
Never paste a secret into chat; enter credentials only through the variable card named by the plan.
Ask each Bot in chat to create its declared routine, then confirm routines_with_runs moves from zero to one.
name: First Hour
policies: READ-ONLY: this pack inspects and reports. It never sends, posts, installs, or writes outside the thread and /tmp.
ONE-COMPUTER: the cloud computer is shared by every Bot on the account. A write here is a write in every other Bot's workspace.
NO-SECRETS-IN-CHAT: credentials are variable names on the variable card, never pasted.
INSTALLED-IS-NOT-WORKING: a connector counts only after one read-only call returned data in this conversation.

routines.name: hello-computer
routines.prompt_hint: Run `uname -a && date -u && pwd` and paste the raw output in a code block, then name the command. Failure is the answer.

routines.name: first-file-desk
routines.prompt_hint: If a file was attached since last run, post five quoted bullets, every date, and the open questions. Else one line: no file.

routines.name: plugin-proof
routines.prompt_hint: Make one read-only call through the selected connector and post a dated line with the real value it returned, or the error verbatim.

approval.scope: attach the file in chat; nothing is read without it

oracle.expected: exactly three blocks: five bullets each with a verbatim quote, every date and deadline or 'no dates', the open questions; nothing else

tagline: One hour, three receipts: the computer answers, a file is read, a connector returns data.
